verdict.rationale: Cake documents an official MCP connection for Claude, Codex, Cursor or any MCP client. It answers questions about shareholders, share classes, option pools, vesting, SAFEs and notes from the live cap table, read-only, so an agent can pull current cap table data before a financing. The reconciliation step relies on the agent combining this with data-room access from elsewhere, since Cake's docs never mention a data room. No OpenAPI or REST spec was found. Missing for 10: any data-room integration or reconciliation feature, a documented structured or bulk export API (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), detail on which MCP tools or data fields are exposed, and independent hands-on corroboration.
